what_this_file_is: A mechanical index of every file in content/evidence/records/. It carries no figure of its own: every number in it counts records, subjects or fields, never passes or rows. Nothing here may be read as a measurement.
reading_rules: Per-count oracle fields are authoritative. Every counts[] element carries its own builds[], build_ambiguity, arch, cpu, excel_bitness, workbook_mode and plumbing, and the record-level `oracle` object is null on every record written by this pass. A build, an architecture or a CPU is never inherited from elsewhere in a document; where the source is silent the field reads not-stated-in-this-record and builds[] is empty with build_ambiguity build-not-stated-in-this-record.

counts[].figure is a verbatim display string. No tool may parse it. passed and total are the only machine-readable numbers, and they are null wherever the source publishes no numerator or no denominator.
handbook_reverified is false on every record. Nothing in this evidence layer has been independently re-measured by the Handbook.
A group-scoped count may never be rendered as a per-surface figure for any of its group_members.

schema_extensions_declared_by_this_pass.why: The build mandate requires the quoted source sentence to travel with every figure. FOUNDATION 2.5 has citation but no slot for the sentence itself.

schema_extensions_declared_by_this_pass.field: counts[].builds / build_ambiguity / arch / cpu / cpu_scoped / excel_bitness / workbook_mode / locale / plumbing / capture_route
schema_extensions_declared_by_this_pass.why: FOUNDATION 2.5 puts these on a record-level oracle object. Hoisting them into each count is what makes "never inherit a build from elsewhere in the document" enforceable when one record carries two counts on two builds (EV-STRUCT-0011, EV-STRUCT-0003).

FOUNDATION 2.5 offers single-build, single-build-not-restated-on-the-scored-line, two-builds-named and sources-contradict. None of them is honest for a rollup that names no build at all - and three do (BUG-FUNC-017 initial run, BUG-FUNC-028 812-case run, the W16 Batch 45 matrix probe). Without this value the only alternatives are to assert a build the source does not state, or to inherit one, both forbidden.

counts[].comparison_predicate is the predicate used to compare OxFunc to Excel. The 15-significant-digit truncation helper is a property of the SURFACE UNDER TEST, not of the oracle comparison. Conflating the two is what inverted FOUNDATION 3.4 on MATCH/XMATCH/DELTA. This field carries each subject's own equality semantics separately, with a code citation.
cited_text_sha256 is only checkable if the byte range it was computed over is published. Every anchor written by this pass records the line range it hashed.

snapshot_warning: This index is a directory listing taken at one moment. It was written while several agents were producing records into the same directory concurrently, and at least one of them cleared the directory before writing its own set. Treat records_indexed and record_id_prefixes_present as a snapshot to be re-derived, never as a completeness claim: a prefix missing from this listing means the listing was taken before that set landed, or after it was removed, not that the records do not exist. Regenerate this file as the last step of any build.
